enchantments.tooltip: Freezing Ice Guard: This item stores the pitiless immovable power of the ice deep within. When the wearer of this item is successfully attacked in melee, this power occasionally comes to the surface, attempting to freeze an enemy solid and encase them in ice.
Inherent Cold Resistance - 5: This item provides a +5 Insight bonus to your Cold resistance.

enchantments.text: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4
enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
Rune Arm Imbue: Cold III: Wearing this Rune Arm will imbue any weapon you wield, dealing 2d6 points of cold damage per hit.
This Rune Arm is craftable and can be customized using recipes at standard crafting devices after disjuncting.
